'''''Eriobotrya deflexa''''', the '''bronze loquat''', is a tree native to China ([[Guangdong]], [[Hainan]]), Taiwan and Vietnam.<ref name=FloraofChina>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=200010829 Flora of China]</ref>

Its leaves are used in Taiwanese folk medicine as an [[expectorant]].<ref>{{cite book|editor-last1=Chiu|editor-first1= N. Y.| editor-last2=Chang|editor-first2=K. H.|title=The Illustrated Medicinal Plants of Taiwan|volume=4|publisher=SMC Publishing Inc.|location=Taipei|year= 1995}}
</ref>

==Hybrids==
[[× Rhaphiobotrya|× ''Rhaphiobotrya'']] is an artificial hybrid genus between species of ''Eriobotrya'' and ''[[Rhaphiolepis]]''.<ref name=POWO_77092237-1>{{Cite POWO|title=× ''Rhaphiobotrya'' Coombes|id=77092237-1|access-date=2024-06-23|mode=cs1}}</ref><ref name=CoomRobe08>{{Cite journal |last1=Coombes |first1=Allen |last2=Robertson |first2=Kenneth |date=2008 |title=An intergeneric hybrid between ''Eriobotrya'' and ''Raphiolepis'' |journal=The Plantsman |series=New Series |volume=7 |issue=3 |pages=162–165 |name-list-style=amp }}</ref> Hybrids include the coppertone loquat (× ''Rhaphiobotrya'' 'Coppertone'), the parents of which are ''Eriobotrya deflexa'' and ''[[Rhaphiolepis indica]]'' or ''R.'' × ''delacourii''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=x ''Rhaphiobotrya'' 'Coppertone' |publisher=Pan Global Plants |url=https://panglobalplants.com/product/x-rhaphiobotrya-coppertone/ |access-date=2024-06-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240623133617/https://panglobalplants.com/product/x-rhaphiobotrya-coppertone/ |archive-date=2024-06-23}}</ref> It is a popular cultivated shrub in the [[Southern United States]] and [[California]].{{citation needed|date=June 2024}}
